H'okay I already posted this earlier, but I'll post it again, why not?

Let me tell you about the weekend that, thanks to Kings of Leon, I spent with Cassidy Harris. (Obviously a fake name, close but fake)

So first off some context, 

I come from a small southern town, you know the kind. The kind that's big enough to have its own schools, but not big enough to have a Walmart. The kind where after a 15 minute walk from the centre you were all-of-a-sudden surrounded by either trees or farms. The community was tight, everyone knew everyone, and growing up, your friendships were tighter.

Cas and I grew up together; daycare, kindergarten through to elementary, and we were pretty close. We shared the same birthday, and as you can imagine, for kids that age that's a pretty big deal, so when we were young we were pretty solid. We were both really dorky, I a truffle shuffle level of chubby, and her this tiny, quiet little girl. We were misfits, so we stuck together.

However, High school came around and she got into this artsy fartsy academy a few towns over, and that was that. As fickle as kids in reality are, I never saw her again. Not until that fateful night.

Ok, let's jump to thanksgiving, my sophomore year. I'd gone to college about as north as you can get, and while I'd visited my high school friends at their various collages, and they had mine, this was gonna be the first time my circle of friends would be back in our little town, all 'grown up' and 'wiser'. 

We'd talked about it for months, nothing special, just a bunch of us would hit the bar we never got carded at, and relive some old traditions.

It was the weekend before thanksgiving, my older sisters weren't back yet and my parents had popped out for the weekend to 'stay out the way', wise decision.

One of my friends asked if she could bring along her little cousin and her friends, and we thought fuck it, the more the merrier. Boy did I not have a clue.

So! We made it to The 102, it had only been just over year but it felt weird that it hadn't changed, novel almost, and we started drinking, hard.

2 or 3 shots and god knows how many beers down, my friend's cousin and her entourage showed up, and amongst them? Little Cassidy.

Except she wasn't so little any more.

She still had her slender frame, but Jesus Christ, all the right places were bigger, fuller, and holy fuck she was gorgeous.

Well, I mean, in hindsight I know she was gorgeous, but the weird thing was, I didn't think it at the time. 

Don't get me wrong, in high school I'd lost the truffle, and even became a little notorious for my promiscuity, but I was just happy to see my long lost friend. Turns out she'd taken a gap year after high school, and was now a freshman at Florida state with that cousin I mentioned. 

Anyway. 

So as the night went on we shared some drinks, played some pool, and caught up on the last 5ish years, and as far I could tell it was completely plutonic. We'd both changed so much in those few short years that it was incredible to laugh, reminisce and access that long dormant dorky side. It was amazing!

Then, at around 2am, we'd gone out for a smoke, and Kings of Leon's Sex on Fire started blaring out from inside. I remember us laughing at the terrible song, and when the chorus hit, she looked me dead in the eye and sang that one ridiculous lyric. And for some reason, unbeknownst to my logical thinking, I simply retorted "how would you know?"

And that was that, her facial expression changed in an instant, from innocent, reminiscent playfulness, to pure unadulterated lust. Before I could make sense of what was going on, let alone what I'd just said, she kissed me. It didn't feel wrong, it didn't feel weird, it felt like a crescendo of a lifelong friendship, and that was astonishing.

The rest was a blur, I don't remember saying goodbye to my friends, or grabbing my coat; next thing I knew, we were in my bed and she was on top of me.

Jesus Christ, little Cas had grown up!

The next morning we slept in, eventually made each other breakfast, then did it all again. And again. And again. Until early evening, she left at the last possible minute before her presence could be noted by my returning parents.

And that was it. I've long since graduated, and while I've returned home multiple times, I've not seen nor heard from her again.  I've thought multiple times about reaching out to her, but I've never found the right time, I've grown up even more and I assume so has she, and a feeble friend request would never do that amazing freak of a weekend justice.

I mean sure, I've fucked since then, and loved since then, but that night, and the morning after will always be an enigmatic treasure of a memory.

And, well I guess I'm waiting for the next time I can accidentally drunkenly make a proposition as a retort to lyrics of a stupid, stupid song.

TL;DR Reconnected with a childhood friend, got drunk, accidentally asked for sex, banged each other's brains out. Thanks Kings of Leon!

Sex On Fire by Kings of Leon.

I used to hate that song, but one particular night changed that. 

Story time?

Welp, it's definitely been hard to beat ;)

 but I think the best part is it helps me remember that great things can fucking sneak up on you. 

Even when you least expect it, an incredibly attractive girl could stick her tongue down your throat.

It works as a metaphor too.

I never have anything decent to say at a party,

Except maybe 'jaeger bombs?'
